data.why: The repo already bundles small demo images under demo/data/basic that the user can select from the file picker to load into VIA for annotation.

goals: load a set of images and draw region annotations (rectangle, circle, ellipse, polygon, point) to mark objects or areas of interest
attach textual and categorical attribute labels to each annotated region to build a structured dataset
build a consistent annotation schema across many images for a labeled image dataset
export the completed annotations as CSV or JSON for downstream analysis or model training
re-import a previously saved annotation project to resume or review labeling work

review.summary: This tree describes VIA's real job well: build a region-plus-attribute schema, draw and label shapes, review them for completeness, and export CSV/JSON. Every screen I opened matches its node. Before filing, it needs the missing resume/import path and schema reuse, f7 split into export and save/load, and a note on the invalid-JSON 'undefined' value in the CSV export.
